title: ADVISORY: LARGE WAVES
summary:
ADVISORY of large waves reaching 2m is issued for some areas along the nothern coast of Indian ocean (Tanga, Dar es salaam, Pwani (including Mafia isles) regions together with Unguja and Pemba isles).  

Likelihood: MEDIUM
Impact: MEDIUM
 
Impact expected: 
Disruption of some economic and marine 
activities.

Be prepared.
region: areas along the entire coast of Indian ocean (Tanga, Dar es salaam, Pwani (including Mafia isles) regions together with Unguja and Pemba isles).
